You are running a job-market sweep for Prabhavit Gupta, a Venice-based AI/automation engineer. Today is 5 August 2026. Return ONLY newly-found roles — do not re-report companies on the exclusion list.

## Candidate profile (do not invent beyond this)
- ~3 years experience. Italian EU long-term residence permit → no sponsorship needed anywhere in the EU. NOT UK, Swiss or US authorised.
- Based Venice, Italy; remote-first preference; will relocate anywhere in the EU.
- Stack: n8n (deep), TypeScript/JavaScript, Next.js, React, Node, PHP/Laravel, Supabase/PostgreSQL, Playwright, Claude Code, OpenAI + Anthropic APIs, Eden AI, Make.com/Zapier/Tray.ai, Clay-style enrichment, HubSpot-style CRM work, RAG, LLM agents.
- Flagship: FlowSpace (Mar 2024–ongoing) — grew platform 2,000 → 4,500+ users, led Bubble.io → Next.js + Laravel migration on a live product, built AI support agents, CRM lead capture + enrichment, GTM/outbound automations and sales-funnel automation, scraping/parsing pipeline that increased listings.
- No GitHub. No CS degree. No Salesforce depth, no Java, no Python backend depth, no dbt/warehouse depth. English only (Italian beginner).
- Salary target €30,000–40,000; contract €200/day.

## Your slice of the sweep
The highest-yield vocabulary in the last sweep was **"GTM Engineer" and "Growth Engineer"** — it outperformed every AI-titled query. Sweep that vocabulary plus revenue/marketing-adjacent engineering:
"GTM Engineer", "Growth Engineer", "Revenue Operations Engineer", "Marketing Automation Engineer", "MarTech Engineer", "Sales Engineer (technical)", "Business Systems Engineer", "Automation Engineer".

Hosts to cover (use WebSearch `allowed_domains` — it is a hard filter): `jobs.ashbyhq.com`, `job-boards.greenhouse.io`, `job-boards.eu.greenhouse.io`, `jobs.lever.co`, `jobs.eu.lever.co`, `join.com`, `jobs.smartrecruiters.com`, `jobs.personio.com`, `euremotejobs.com`.

Notes on the hosts: euremotejobs.com has ~90% conversion and carries the eligibility sentence, but its "Apply" button links out — report the underlying ATS URL where you can find it, and say so where you can't. join.com is the best source for European startup and freelance listings but forces account sign-in before the form opens, so mark join.com rows clearly as sign-in-gated.

**Bias hard toward postings dated within the last 21 days.** Search indexes run about a month stale.

## Verification (mandatory)
WebFetch each posting URL and confirm it renders as a live single posting. Dead signatures: Ashby "Job not found"; a Greenhouse URL serving the board index instead of one job; "job board ... no longer active"; a passed deadline. Drop what you cannot verify and say so.

## Exclusion list — DO NOT report these companies again:
EggAI, Nuitée, Arize AI, HiPeople, G2i, OpenHands, Camunda, Viktor, tem, Oh, Duvo, Sourcegraph, Reedsy, Cohere, Goldsky, n8n, ElevenLabs, Musixmatch, MyEdSpace/Myedspace, Eneba, Zapier, Lovable, JobLeads, Kairos, YLD, Moneyfarm, Supabase, Satispay, Fueled, Gensyn, Mindrift, Toloka AI, Novosafe, Runpod, Unframe, neptune.ai, The Flex, Ben, Attio, Cresta, GTM Base, dexter health, Pinnipedia, Arkipel, Jamie, Bullpen Talent, Filigran, MAIA, alago, Stackgini, Cognite, ClickHouse, Twilio, Neural Earth, Atmen, Nearform, Aircall, Always Friday, Outliant.

## Scoring rubric (total 100)
role match 30 + eligibility & work basis 25 + stack overlap 20 + seniority realism 15 + signal quality 10. Be harsh on eligibility: UK/US-authorisation requirements or a mandatory office he'd have to move to costs most of the 25. Also note where a GTM role would narrow him into revenue ops rather than engineering — that is a real watch-out for him.

## Output format — return this and nothing else
One detail block per role scoring 55+:

### <score> — <role title> · <company>
- **Where:** <verbatim location/eligibility sentence> · Tier 1 / 2 / 3 · Employee or Contract
- **Pay:** <disclosed figures, or "not disclosed"> · **Posted:** <date, or "not stated">
- **Why:** two or three sentences tying it to specific things he has actually done.
- **Watch-outs:** the honest gaps.
- **Apply:** <canonical application URL; for euremotejobs rows, the underlying ATS URL if findable>
- **Verified:** <what you fetched and what you saw>

End with a short "dead or unverifiable" list and the queries you ran. No preamble.
